title: Deno Deploy Shuts Down. No Date.
caption:
I almost moved a side project onto Deno Deploy in August.

On October 9 Ryan Dahl announced the entire Deno team is joining Cloudflare. Deploy keeps operating for six months and then shuts down. The runtime gets twelve more months of monthly bug-fix and security releases, then Deno ends its development of it. JSR stays up, with its infrastructure moving to Cloudflare.

The part I keep staring at: there is no calendar date anywhere in that post. Everyone is counting six months from October 9 and printing April 2027, but that is our arithmetic, not Deno's commitment. And the migration support to Workers was promised to paying customers — the free tier never comes up.

Deploy, Workers, or somewhere else?
